main.description: Get an HLS CMAF playlist for a video. Returns a master playlist when `track` is omitted, or a single-track media playlist when `track` is supplied. The playlist references each segment + per-track init segment via getVideoBlob, addressed by content hash.

did.description: DID of the video creator (the repo holding the place.stream.video record).

rkey.description: Record key of the place.stream.video record.

track.description: Track ID (stringified u32 matching the MUXL container) for a single-track media playlist. Omit for the master playlist.

start.description: Start time in nanoseconds from the beginning of the video. Defaults to 0.

end.description: End time in nanoseconds. Omit to include all remaining content.

errors.name: VideoNotFound
errors.description: No place.stream.video record indexed for this DID and rkey.

errors.name: TrackNotFound
errors.description: The requested track ID is not present in the video's blob.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: The video record references a blob this node hasn't indexed an origin for.
